notes.title: Domination Mode Launch Event: Special Discount Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
🚀 Update Alert! 🚀

Get ready to dominate the virtual battlefield like never before in ShadowStorm! We're thrilled to introduce our latest game-changing addition: Domination Mode!

In Domination Mode, it's all about strategic control and tactical prowess. Here's what you need to know:

🏆 Objective: Capture and hold designated zones within your opponent's territory to earn points. The longer your team maintains control, the more points you accrue.

⚔️ Strategic Gameplay: Coordinate with your team to secure key positions on the map and fend off enemy advances. Communication and teamwork are crucial for success in this intense battle for dominance.

🔥 Fast-Paced Action: Prepare for adrenaline-pumping action as you engage in fierce battles to seize control of the battlefield. Every decision counts as you vie for supremacy against rival teams.

🤖 Play with Bots: Can't assemble a full team? No problem! Domination Mode supports bot players, allowing you to fill in the gaps with AI-controlled allies or opponents. Perfect for sharpening your skills or enjoying a quick match anytime, anywhere.

🌎 Dynamic Environments: Immerse yourself in immersive VR environments that come to life as you fight for control. From sprawling urban landscapes to treacherous wilderness, each map offers unique challenges and opportunities for domination.

🎉 Discount Alert: Enjoy a Special Launch Discount! 🎉

Are you ready to lead your team to victory and assert your dominance on the battlefield? Gather your allies, hone your strategies, and prepare for the ultimate showdown in Domination Mode!

Update your game now on Steam and experience the thrill of conquest in ShadowStorm!

See you on the frontlines!

notes.title: Introducing vote system !
notes.content:
🎉 Exciting Update Alert! 🎉

We're thrilled to announce the latest update to ShadowStorm, now available on Steam! Get ready to experience gaming like never before with our newest feature: End-of-Game Voting!

Now, at the conclusion of each match, players will have the power to shape their next gaming experience. Here's what you can expect:

🗳️ Vote for New Maps: Tired of playing on the same battleground? Now you can have your say in which map to explore next. Choose from a variety of captivating environments to keep the action fresh and exhilarating.

🎮 Select New Game Modes: Spice up your gameplay by voting for a new game mode at the end of each match. Whether you're craving fast-paced action or strategic challenges, there's something for everyone.

👥 Team Selection: Ever wanted to stick with the same group of players for consecutive matches? Now you can! Vote for your preferred team at the end of the game and embark on a series of matches with your chosen allies.

With these new features, you can dive into multiple matches seamlessly, without the hassle of constantly reassembling lobbies. It's all about giving you, the players, more control over your gaming experience.

Update your game now on Steam and start shaping your gaming destiny with ShadowStorm!

notes.title: Dystrovia is Available !
notes.content:
[h1][b]Can you survive on Dystrovia[/b][/h1]

Explore the depths and misty streets of Dystrovia; this new map will take you into the midst of urban battles in the heart of a megalopolis that reeks of pollution and corruption. Immerse yourself in the dark atmosphere of Dark Alley, where grimy skyscrapers conceal secrets as twisted as the winding alleys.

Faulty neon lights flicker weakly, casting eerie shadows on graffiti-covered walls. The sizzling sounds of rats feasting on garbage echo through narrow alleys, and every street corner seems to harbor a potential threat. Once thriving shopping centers, now dilapidated buildings serve as hideouts for rival factions vying for power.

Urban combat in Dark Alley demands agility and tactical intelligence. Use the environment to your advantage, from the corners of the alleys to unstable balconies, to gain the upper hand against your enemies. Muffled footsteps and low murmurs of conspiracies give this urban environment a unique character, where survival depends as much on your ability to navigate the shadows as on your combat skills.

Confront rival gangs, corrupt mercenaries, and venal law enforcement in this sinister area of Dystrovia. Every street corner hides high stakes, hidden treasures, and deadly risks. Will you be able to unveil the mysteries lurking in the darkness of Dark Alley, or will you simply be engulfed by the dark secrets of this fallen metropolis?
